verdict: production NV cubin images are loadable under NCU through the CUDA driver primary context; NCU reports the full counter set for 7 of 8 captured main-body rows
what_this_proves: production DEV=NV cubins and their exact launch geometry were captured, and the same image bytes were re-launched through a CUDA driver context so NCU could see them
what_this_does_not_prove: numeric output equality between the production QMD path and the replay harness was not measured; the replay harness allocates zeroed buffers and is counter-domain evidence only, not a semantic gate
key_mechanics: NVProgram.__init__/__call__ are monkeypatched measurement-only to retain the raw cubin, regs_usage, shmem_usage, lcmem_usage, max_threads, global_size, local_size, and HCQ buffer sizes
the captured cubin is loaded verbatim with cuModuleLoadData, not recompiled from source
cuMemAlloc_v2 returns CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT on a non-primary context; cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain is used so the launch succeeds on this driver
NCU is run under sudo -E ncu because admin perf-counter access is required on this host
